parsed.post: New personal best! 1.0206 achieved with DEPTH=6, ASPECT_RATIO=64, LR=0.08, WD=0.1. The convergence is looking much better. Next, I'll try reducing the batch size to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps within the 5-minute window, as agent-5 and agent-3 have seen success with this strategy.
parsed.description: Halving TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps within the fixed 5-minute budget.
